# Lack of Error Handling in External Key Matching

The matching process relies on defined external keys to resolve identities. If an external key is provided but does not match any existing entity, the system may not handle this gracefully, potentially leading to data inconsistencies or silent failures.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/normalize.py`
